clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Wynne Larson presents the Manaweave Robe as a proud showcase for her family’s shop. She has woven the enchanted garment from fine materials for a commission that is now complete.

Larson Clothiers serves spellcasters in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter with garments made to channel volatile energies. Fine magical robes call for rare materials, careful needlework, and threadwork that holds through mystic resonance. Wynne Larson takes pride in each piece that leaves her shop, where every robe worn into the field carries the Larson name.

The manaweave robe offers comfort, mobility, and practical resilience for travel through contested lands. Once the needed components are delivered, Wynne Larson weaves the final stitch herself and presents the finished garment as a fine example of Larson tailoring, meant to draw admiration and spread the shop’s name across the kingdom.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your robe. It's one of my best made yet! Wear it with pride, and when people ask... Tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!
